additional_info.subject: 0412115 - ID0411877-DC/Si-D/FR- [ Y2 / PD 312571675/22] Firmware Update (C1) CRM:00646000026
additional_info.body:
Hi Sambath,
I went on site this afternoon to look at the problem. The OCPP connection is ok from our side but it is the scb connection that has problem.
The siemens routeur is almost all the time out. It is not possible to see it in ethernet connection. During my 1h30 intervention, it went on once.
The charger tries to reboot but it is stuck at 30%, that means router problem? I think that the update creates a problem inside the charger.
Can you please ask for an on-site intervention with the needed spare parts? I think, the siemens router can be replaced.
Here are some pictures that I took.
Siemens routeur (on once during 1h30)
OCPP routeur (on all the time during 1h30)
State blocked during reboot

Je suis passé sur site et ai remarqué que la porte ne ferme pas très bien. Une fois la porte fermée, l’espacement entre la porte et le bâtis est plus important que sur les bornes voisines.
Pourras-tu stp vérifier que la borne ne se met pas en erreur à cause du capteur de porte lors de ton départ et faire le nécessaire en cas de besoin ?
